moments.author: Chord Overstreet
moments.quote: Reunited and it feels so good!
moments.why: Because it cryptically confirmed his return to the highly anticipated ‘Glee’ reboot and delighted longtime fans.

moments.author: Matthew Rettenmund
moments.quote: RIP “Shazam!” star and ‘70s teen heartthrob Michael Gray. He was 75. Those shows (“Isis,” “Electra Woman”) were formative for me.
moments.why: Because it was one of the more personal tributes that resonated with fans who grew up watching Michael Gray in classic 1970s shows.
